name: Zuowei Youxi He Shige De Shijie
original_name: 作为游戏和诗歌的世界
source: Yor Alef and his sister Anya Alef were abandoned by their parents due to illness when they were young and were later taken in by a pub owner named Siobhan in Dublin, Ireland. During a business trip, Yor unexpectedly encounters a mysterious girl from his dreams, who turns out to be named Elwyn. Faced with this familiar yet unfamiliar girl, Yor and she embark on a journey to collect manuscripts and uncover the truth about their past.
translation: 约尔·阿莱夫（Yor Alef）和妹妹安雅·阿莱夫（Anya Alef）幼年时因病被父母抛弃，后来被爱尔兰都柏林一位名叫西沃恩（Siobhan）的酒吧老板收养。在一次出差期间，尤尔意外地遇到了梦中的神秘女孩，她的名字叫艾尔文。面对这个熟悉又陌生的女孩，约尔和她踏上了收集手稿并揭开过去真相的旅程。
